overview: Autism spectrum disorders are a diverse group of conditions characterized by difficulty with social interaction and communication, and atypical patterns of activities and behaviors. The abilities and needs of autistic people vary and can evolve over time. While some people with autism can live independently, others have severe disabilities and require life-long care and support.
symptoms: Atypical patterns of activities and behaviors
Difficulty with transition from one activity to another
prevention: Avoidance of maternal diabetes during pregnancy
Avoidance of prenatal exposure to air pollutants or certain heavy metals
Avoidance of prematurity, severe birth complications and low birth weight
risk_factors: Prenatal exposure to air pollutants or certain heavy metals
Prematurity, severe birth complications and low birth weight
complications: Impact on education and employment opportunities
key_facts: About 1 in 127 persons had autism in 2021
The prevalence of autism in many low- and middle-income countries is unknown
Other childhood vaccines do not increase the risk of autism
